facts.text: Canyon Ranch Lenox was named the number one spa resort in New England by the Michelin Guide 2026.
facts.excerpt: Named the #1 Spa Resort in New England by the Michelin Guide 2026

facts.text: The resort sits on 120 acres of wooded land just outside Lenox, Massachusetts.
facts.excerpt: Perched on 120 acres of wooded land just outside of Lenox, Massachusetts

facts.text: The property is about one mile from downtown Lenox.
facts.excerpt: The property is about one mile from downtown Lenox

facts.text: The grounds are anchored by Bellefontaine Mansion, built in 1897.
facts.excerpt: The grounds here are anchored by Bellefontaine Mansion (which is home to the on-site restaurant), built in 1897.

facts.text: Bellefontaine Mansion was inspired by the Petit Trianon at Versailles and later served as a Jesuit seminary.
facts.excerpt: a 1897 estate inspired by the Petit Trianon at Versailles that later served as a Jesuit seminary

facts.text: Long glass-enclosed corridors let guests move between rooms, dining, the spa and fitness facilities without going outdoors.
facts.excerpt: These corridors allow guests to move between rooms, dining spaces, the spa, and fitness facilities without going outdoors

facts.text: The corridors double as informal galleries lined with work by regional artists.
facts.excerpt: double as informal galleries lined with work by regional artists

facts.text: Canyon Ranch Lenox opened in 1989 as the brand's second property after its original Arizona location.
facts.excerpt: Canyon Ranch Lenox opened in 1989, the brand's second property after its original Arizona location.

facts.text: Canyon Ranch Lenox is an adults-only, all-inclusive wellness resort in the Berkshires.
facts.excerpt: An adults-only, all-inclusive wellness resort in the Berkshires

facts.text: The spa and wellness facilities span roughly 100,000 square feet.
facts.excerpt: Canyon Ranch Lenox’s spa and wellness facilities span roughly 100,000 square feet

facts.text: Treatment rooms, saunas, steam rooms and whirlpools are housed under one roof in the spa and fitness complex.
facts.excerpt: Treatment rooms, locker facilities, saunas, steam rooms, whirlpools, and other thermal amenities are housed under one roof

facts.text: The spa menu has more than 150 treatments drawing on Eastern and Western traditions.
facts.excerpt: The treatment menu is extensive, with more than 150 offerings ranging from standard massages and bodywork to therapies drawn from both Eastern and Western traditions.

facts.text: The massage menu includes outdoor massages such as the Outdoor Open Sky Massage.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor Open Sky Massage

facts.text: The spa offers Ayurvedic treatments.
facts.excerpt: Ayurvedic Treatments

facts.text: Shirodhara is on the Ayurvedic treatment menu.
facts.excerpt: Shirodhara

facts.text: The resort offers more than 35 optional activities daily.
facts.excerpt: 35+ Daily Optional Activities

facts.text: Swimming pools and aquatic activities are always included.
facts.excerpt: Swimming Pools & Aquatic Activities

facts.text: Round-trip transportation is always included.
facts.excerpt: Round-Trip Transportation

facts.text: Unlimited meals, snacks and beverages at the on-site restaurants are included.
facts.excerpt: Savor unlimited meals, snacks, and beverages at our on-site restaurants

facts.text: Culinary Rebel serves a take on Mediterranean classics with a view of the great lawn.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy meals featuring our nutritious and comforting take on Mediterranean classics. Service is fast causal, allowing for an expedited dining experience, while enjoying the beautiful view of the great lawn.

facts.text: Silverleaf serves seasonal, regional dishes, with vegan and gluten-free options.
facts.excerpt: Seasonal, regional dishes are prepared using fresh, wholesome ingredients free of additives and unhealthy extras. Vegan and gluten-free options available.

facts.text: The Demo Kitchen hosts lunch-and-learn sessions and hands-on cooking classes.
facts.excerpt: the Demo Kitchen operates as both a dining destination and a teaching space, hosting lunch-and-learn sessions and hands-on cooking classes

facts.text: Rooms have large windows looking out onto trees and landscaped grounds.
facts.excerpt: large windows look out onto trees and landscaped grounds

facts.text: Tanglewood and The Mount are a short drive away.
facts.excerpt: Cultural landmarks such as Tanglewood and The Mount are a short drive away and especially appealing in summer

facts.text: The resort runs limited-time, expert-led events and retreats on health and wellness.
facts.excerpt: Join an intimate, like-minded group of guests for limited-time, expert-led events that explore the latest in health and wellness.

facts.text: The Stay Your Way package includes a nightly $200 Spa and Fitness Credit.
facts.excerpt: Our most flexible experience, featuring a nightly $200 Spa & Fitness Credit.

facts.text: Alcohol is available at dinner for an additional charge and is absent from daytime meals.
facts.excerpt: Alcohol is available at dinner for an additional charge, but plays a minor role overall and is absent from daytime meals.

facts.text: Most public spaces, including dining areas, spa and fitness facilities, are reachable without stairs.
facts.excerpt: most public spaces—including the dining areas, spa, and fitness facilities—are reachable without stairs

facts.text: Private sessions, specialized consultations and select activities are priced a la carte unless bundled into a package or retreat.
facts.excerpt: Private sessions, specialized consultations, and select activities are priced à la carte unless bundled into one of the aforementioned packages or retreats.

facts.text: With winding corridors and sprawling grounds, the property can feel like a maze for first-timers.
facts.excerpt: the property can feel like a maze, especially if you're a first-timer

facts.text: Canyon Ranch Lenox was a Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards winner in 2026.
